points.text: My production stack for agent pipelines
Rakes that cost me days of debugging (save these, no need to step on them yourself):

Rake 1: a Docker port on 0.0.0.0 bypasses the firewall The first server self-scan on October 1, 2026 found the no-code orchestrator's (n8n) web interface exposed directly to the internet: Docker published 0.0.0.0:5678 outside the host firewall.
Rake 2: a green container is not a live pipeline The mail agent lost Gmail access (token refresh failed).
Rake 3: a service without a model gateway key silently found nothing The log accumulated 684,837 refusals until a missing key was made fatal at startup.
Rake 4: there is no per-run limit A stuck queue turned every tick into hundreds of calls.
